traditional: 覺得 N 做乜都係為自己
jyutping: gok3 dak1 N zou6 mat1 dou1 hai6 wai6 zi6 gei2

english.note: Use this construction for the worldview that people act mainly or only out of self-interest.

examples.english: I’m cynical and think people do everything for themselves.
examples.traditional: 我覺得人哋做乜都係為自己。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 jan4 dei6 zou6 mat1 dou1 hai6 wai6 zi6 gei2
